action.name: Fixed 2200 single-write trial with Synapse recovery
action.value: One acknowledged Fixed 2200 write, no OpenBlade Auto write, then vendor-controlled Auto restoration on Synapse boot

validation.applyResult: The exact Fixed 2200 setter was applied once and returned a status-02 semantic acknowledgement.
validation.readbackResult: The post-write query succeeded as a transaction but returned configured target 1550 instead of 2200, so the Fixed target was not independently confirmed.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully through the vendor controller: Synapse booted and the operator confirmed that it automatically returned the pad to Auto.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: After Synapse fully exited, an independent read-only query confirmed configured target zero while both stored cooling-mode banks remained unchanged.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validator confirmed the exact host and pad, inactive Synapse and OpenBlade service, and a readable configured-target baseline before issuing one Fixed write.
One Fixed 2200 request was acknowledged, but the immediate configured-target query returned 1550 rather than 2200. No retry and no OpenBlade Auto command followed.
Synapse booted after the bounded trial and the operator confirmed that the pad automatically returned to Auto. Synapse was then fully closed before an independent read-only query.

The exact read-only post-recovery query returned configured target zero. The firmware and Synapse cooling-mode banks still returned their stored values, confirming that those banks are not active-mode readback.

limitations: The Fixed setter acknowledgement did not prove the requested target, active fan mode, physical fan motion, ownership, or safe standalone control.
Configured-target readback changed from 1600 to 1550 after the Fixed 2200 write. The cause is unresolved and the result does not admit the setter.
Synapse restored Auto on boot, but this is vendor-controlled recovery rather than an independently reproduced OpenBlade Auto handback.
The unchanged firmware and Synapse cooling-mode banks are stored configuration banks, not an active-controller or active-mode discriminator.
The current-speed candidate getter remains unsupported, and no tachometer readback is available.
The private write and post-recovery transcripts remain uncommitted.

productionAdmission.reason: The single Fixed write was acknowledged but did not produce the expected configured-target readback. Only Synapse restored Auto safely, so OpenBlade fan mutation remains unadmitted.

notes: The trial deliberately omitted the previously unsafe standalone OpenBlade Auto command.
USBPcap was not running and the installed OpenBlade service remained stopped.
Razer Game Manager Service 3 and Razer Elevation Service were restored after both bounded OpenBlade sessions.
